items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: So we were there for a year and we got to meet everybody who came through The Sands. Now that’s Sinatra, Nat King Cole, Jerry Lewis, on and on and on.

ctx.x: In the summer we would take them on the road with us again. We’d go to Reno, go to Lake Tahoe, then make a swing through San Francisco and go down to L.A. and back to Las Vegas, and this time go into The Sands for a year, opposite the Red Norvo Quintet. And that was wonderful, because here we had a good group, a tight group, and Red had a
fantastic group. So we were there for a year and we got to meet everybody who came through The Sands. Now that’s Sinatra, Nat King Cole, Jerry Lewis, on and on and on.
